name: Nobu Hotel Ibiza Bay
positioning: Beachfront hotel on the shores of Talamanca Bay, a short walk along the promenade from Marina Botafoch and Ibiza's old town
best_for: Travelers who want to step straight from the hotel onto the beach, close to Ibiza Town
Families with children aged 4 to 12 who will use the Kid's Club

facts.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Talamanca Bay in Ibiza.
The beach promenade is right outside, and a short walk leads to the boutiques and restaurants of Marina Botafoch and the old town.
Dalt Vila and Ibiza Old Town are 10 minutes away by car.
The airport is 12 minutes away by car.
Rooms use soft furnishings in a palette of whites, golds, blues and aqua.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and open terraces.
Room details include hand-crafted ceramics and natural woven lamps.
The Grand Suites are the Penthouse, Presidential, Royal Suite, Rooftop Junior Suite and One-bedroom Suite Seaview.
The adults pool has oversized day-beds and sun loungers.
The spa offers skincare products and treatments by Dr. Barbara Sturm.
The Kid's Club is for children aged 4 to 12 and offers DJ workshops.
The Nobu restaurant serves Nobu Matsuhisa's signature Japanese dishes such as Yellowtail Sashimi with Jalapeno and Black Cod Miso.

highlights.text: Guests can step from the hotel straight onto the sandy beach.
The hotel has two outdoor pools facing the sea, steps from the beach.
Bedrooms look out to sea and sunrise views of the Illa Grossa peninsula and the Cap Martinet headland.
The spa is Ibiza Bay Spa by Six Senses.
Dogs are welcome, and the hotel has a Dog Spaw created with Charlie & Co Naturals.

considerations.text: The hotel operates seasonally; this season it is open until 26 October.
Bali beds around the adults pool require a minimum food and drink spend.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
